tagline: Because your desert safari needed a $200k Italian supercar, now with added dust and questionable life choices.

title: Blade Runner: Home Edition
tagline: For when you're carving a Thanksgiving turkey in a blackout, but also want to subtly intimidate your in-laws. This knife turns your kitchen into a nightclub—just don’t ask the health inspector about the strobe effect. Perfect for midnight snack raids or convincing your cat you’re a superhero.

title: Madman's Three-Wheeled Dream
tagline: For when you need to commute to your therapist appointment in style, this 3-wheel supercharged hypermotard is the perfect vehicle to arrive at your 'I'm having a midlife crisis' session.

title: Sith Lord’s BBQ Dreams
tagline: When your backyard cookout needs the dark side’s approval. Perfect for grilling steaks while your neighbors debate whether you’re a Star Wars fan or just really into intimidating patio decor. Bonus: The force-choke feature is purely decorative (unfortunately).

title: Vintage Speed for a Fortune
tagline: Imagine needing to impress your 1950s-themed book club. You pull up in this, the Ferrari 500 TRC, and suddenly everyone’s talking about your 'authentic vintage experience.' Just don’t forget to budget for the vintage mechanic who’ll spend more time admiring it than fixing it.

title: Triple the Wheels, Triple the Confusion
tagline: For when you want to split lanes but also need the stability of a shopping cart. Perfect for the urban commuter who’s equal parts daredevil and hypochondriac. Just imagine weaving through traffic while your friends in cars stare in bewilderment. Bonus: It’s the only bike where you can blame a third wheel for your dating life.

title: Kame House in Your Pocket
tagline: Because your office cubicle needs a 3D Goku mid-Kamehameha. Perfect for when your boss asks why you’re late again—just say you were ‘training with the Z Fighters.’ The hologram won’t save you from HR, but at least you’ll die with style.

title: Racing on Your Couch
tagline: For when you want to feel like a pro racer, but your commute is the only lap you'll ever run. This $73,592 simulator brings the track to your living room, because who needs human interaction anyway?

title: Slide Into Regret
tagline: For the friend who thinks a 30-second commute to the kitchen is too long, this absurdly long water slide is the answer. Now they can slide from bedroom to fridge, because walking is overrated.

title: Mood Swing Machine
tagline: For when you need to cry at a wedding, this device induces feelings on demand. Because who needs emotional authenticity?

title: Single Lane Supercar
tagline: For when you want to spend $119,700 on a car that's only good for driving in a straight line, like a really expensive, high-speed trip to the in-laws' house.

title: Luxury for the Lake
tagline: For when you need to impress your yacht club friends, but still want to get a tan, the Rolls-Royce Boat Tail Convertible is the absurdly extravagant answer to a question no one asked.

title: Drone Overlord Arrives
tagline: Because you clearly need a $2,499 drone to follow you around the backyard while you mow the lawn, judging your every move.

title: Wall of Sound Chaos
tagline: For when you want to confuse your neighbors with a mural that's also blasting music, because who needs a social life?

title: Tentacles in Your Ears
tagline: For when you want to block out your roommate's snoring and simultaneously confuse them into thinking you're a sea creature, these rainbow tentacle ear plugs are a thing that exists.

title: Mood Ring for Pets
tagline: For when you need to know your cat's disdain for you is at an all-time high, this harness displays their emotions, because reading their minds wasn't enough.

title: Glass Ceiling for DJs
tagline: For when your DJ set needs to look like a futuristic aquarium. Perfect for the 'I spend more on gear than rent' crowd. Imagine explaining to your landlord why you need a see-through touchscreen to play 'YMCA' at 3 AM. Bonus: Watch your audience’s confused reflections while you pretend to be a hologram.

title: Ball of Confusion (Three Dimensional)
tagline: For when your cat's laser pointer obsession has evolved into a full-blown existential crisis. This $40k labyrinth orb isn't just a toy—it's a metaphor for life's endless twists and turns. Perfect for the high-stakes game of 'find the exit before your boss walks in.'

title: Flip Off Decor
tagline: For when you want to subtly express disdain to your in-laws during the holidays, this giant middle finger statue is a thoughtful addition to your dinner table centerpiece.
